Property Summary
No. 10 Southbay Strand is a beautiful first-floor apartment presented in fabulous condition and meticulously maintained throughout. The apartment is well laid out, with an entrance hallway leading to all rooms.  The spacious living/dining area features an electric stove, creating a warm and homely atmosphere, with a fully fitted kitchen just off this space.  There are two generous double bedrooms, one of which includes an en-suite, while a large main bathroom completes the accommodation.  Situated within Southbay Point in Rosslare Strand, the property enjoys a quiet, well-kept seaside setting with a relaxed coastal feel. The development consists of modern homes in a tidy, landscaped estate just a short walk from a long sandy beach. The surrounding area further enhances its appeal, with Rosslare Europort only a short drive away (approx. 10 minutes), offering ferry links and transport connections, while  Wexford Town is within easy reach (approx. 20 minutes) for a wider range of shops, restaurants, and services. Dublin is also accessible at approximately a 2-hour drive, making the property convenient for travel to the capital. The property is also ideally positioned just a short stroll from local tennis courts and within minutes of the renowned Kelly's Resort Hotel, offering leisure facilities, dining, and a vibrant social atmosphere.  No. 10 Southbay Strand presents a wonderful opportunity to acquire a stylish coastal home in one of Wexford’s most sought-after seaside locations. Whether as a permanent residence, holiday retreat, or investment property, it offers the perfect balance of comfort, convenience, and relaxed coastal living. Early viewing is highly recommended to truly appreciate all that this exceptional apartment has to offer. VIEWING HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.
